claims.text: The share of negative reviews mentioning platform policy increased by 22.84 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline.
Off-topic reviews accounted for 3.98 percentage points of negative reviews in the window, up from 0% in the baseline.
The volume of reviews spiked significantly starting on September 23, 2026, with 358 reviews compared to the daily average of 45-60 in the preceding days of the window.

findings.title: Off-topic reviews or a review bomb

report.summary: Negative reviews mentioning platform policy rose 22.84 percentage points during the window. Off-topic reviews accounted for 3.98 percentage points of negative reviews, and the volume of reviews spiked to 358 on September 23, 2026, compared to the daily average of 45-60. The explanation regarding off-topic reviews or a review bomb is supported. The explanation regarding noise or seasonality is rejected. The explanations regarding the patch, a price change or sale, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive.
